title: Match structure — best-of-3 rounds + match-resolve banner + tally reset (MVP-2 session transition)
intent: Kaboom Crew is currently an endless-round-loop game: rounds resolve, tally bumps, auto-restart fires, repeat forever. `gdd.md §Round structure (planned, MVP-2)` documented the intended next step: a 'match' = best-of-3 decisive rounds. When the tally reaches the threshold (default 3 decisive rounds, draws don't count), a MATCH-RESOLVED banner shows, the tally resets to 0/0/0, and a longer pause precedes the next match. This adds session shape — a clear endpoint, a clear winner per match — without complicating the existing round mechanics. Critical for multiplayer where players want a 'natural break' moment to leave / refresh / etc. without losing their progress.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gdd.md` Round structure planned-MVP-2 section + `gameplay-systems.md §6.3` ('A match is a best-of-3 rounds. When tally.player + tally.bot + tally.draws reaches a configurable target...'). The current endless loop was the right MVP-1 shape but starts to feel unstructured once players hang around for many rounds. Multiplayer especially benefits: players who join, want a clear 'play 1 match then leave' arc. Sized `should` because the existing endless loop continues to work — match structure is polish on top. Coordinates cleanly with multiplayer Sprint B+C: matches become natural drop-in/out boundaries (spectate-until-next-MATCH instead of spectate-until-next-ROUND for some scenarios).
acceptanceHints: Does NOT depend on multiplayer Sprint B/C; can ship in solo mode first and extend when multiplayer landed.
Schema: a new MatchState singleton component (mirrors RoundState's pattern). Lives on the kaboom.game-state entity.
MatchState { phase: 'playing' | 'resolved', target: integer (default 3), resolved_at?: number, last_match_winner?: 'player' | 'bot' | 'draw' }

RoundResolveSystem extends: after bumping tally, check if `max(tally.player, tally.bot) >= MatchState.target`. If so → MatchState.phase = 'resolved', last_match_winner = whoever hit target (or 'draw' if tied after target rounds — rare with best-of-3).
MATCH-RESOLVED behaviour:

Normal auto-restart pauses MatchState-aware: when MatchState.phase = 'resolved', the post-round pause extends from 3s to 7s (configurable). Gives the match-end banner time to land + audience to process.
After the extended pause: MatchState.phase = 'playing', tally resets to 0/0/0, RoundState.roundNumber resets to 1. Scene reload as normal.
RoundState.roundNumber resets per-match, NOT per-game. The 'I am on round 5 of the current match' read becomes 'round 5 / 3 of match N'.
HUD CHANGES:
Bottom-left tally line gains a match indicator: `Match 3 | Round 2/3 | W:1 L:1 D:0` (or compact equivalent).
Centre banner on match-resolve: 'MATCH 3 — YOU WIN' / 'MATCH 3 — YOU LOSE' / 'MATCH 3 — DRAW'. Visually distinct from per-round banner (larger text, longer hold).
Match-resolve banner colour from `visual-style.md §5.2` (H3 green for player-win, H0 red for player-loss, H1 orange for draw — reuse round-resolve banner palette).
PERSISTENT MATCH NUMBER:
MatchState gains a `matchNumber: integer` that increments each match. Survives auto-restart same as RoundState.roundNumber+tally already do (via bootstrap restartScene re-seed).
HUD shows current match number — gives the round-after-round feel a hierarchical structure.
URL CONFIG:
`?matchTarget=N` overrides the default best-of-3 → best-of-N (1 = single round wins match; 5 = best-of-5; useful for tournaments).
AUDIO:
Match-resolve fires a longer fanfare than round-resolve. New audio event: `match-resolved` distinct from `round-resolved`.
Vocal-synth (GDP-008 / shipped S110) victory slot also fires for the MATCH winner, not just the round winner. Slightly extends the speech-like utterance for impact.
MULTIPLAYER COORDINATION (forward-compatible):

When multiplayer Sprint C (GDP-2026-05-22-012) lands, spectate-until-next-MATCH becomes an optional join policy (server-config flag). For long matches it's nicer than spectate-until-next-round; for short matches it's overkill. Default stays per-round; per-match is opt-in.
Server is authoritative on MatchState same as RoundState. Both flip in lockstep via snapshot.
DETERMINISM:
Match-resolve check is deterministic — based on tally comparison only. Same gameplay → same match outcomes.
ACCEPTANCE PLAYTEST:
Solo mode: play 3 rounds, win 2 of 3 → match-resolve banner fires + 7s pause + new match starts with tally 0/0/0 and matchNumber 2.
Draws don't count: play 5 rounds with 2 wins + 2 losses + 1 draw → no match resolve yet; round 6 with a win → match resolves at 3 wins.
Best-of-1: ?matchTarget=1 → every round-resolve is a match-resolve.
HUD reads naturally during play — players can tell which round of which match they're on.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Sets / series / tournaments (best-of-3 matches comprise a set, etc.). Single match is the unit.
Match history / leaderboard (no persistent profile yet).
Custom match-resolve celebrations (animations, fireworks). Banner + audio + vocal is enough for MVP-2.
Per-arena match-target override (one global ?matchTarget for now).
Spectator-only mode (separate to spectate-until-next-round mid-round join).
